Maya: Quick decision: proposed format for the May workshop  a hands-on "Tuning the Inference Stack" session where attendees try batching/quantization knobs live, plus a short benchmark narrative. Need to finalize: 1) format (single presenter vs mini-panel), 2) timing (45/15 vs 40/20), 3) speaker roster, 4) greenroom roles, 5) live polling plan, and 6) fallback. Please call out volunteers and blockers. Abstracts + one-slide outline due Fri. @Sam @Priya input?
Sam: I like hands-on + short benchmark narrative. Audience can toggle batch size and see latency/cost numbers update. Volunteer to lead the demo. Preference for 45/15 to give room for live tuning Qs.
Priya: Agree on 45/15. Suggest we add two short live polls to surface attendee baseline (e.g., "What % of requests need <200ms?"). That helps shape demo choices. I can draft poll copy.
Jordan: Recommend mini-panel (Sam + Eng lead + customer) for the narrative piece. Panel can field deeper questions while demo runs.
Elena: I'll own slide template and the single-slide outline. Also need to confirm captions and recording policy. We should announce recording in the intro slide + consent for any customer quotes.
Ash: I'll own infra. Fallback options: A) Switch to prerecorded guided demo with live Q&A, B) Run the benchmark narrative with slides + deep-dive appendix if demo fails. I'll prepare a 3-minute warmup script to validate endpoints before go-live.
Maya: Great. Volunteers so far: Sam (demo lead), Ash (infra/fallback), Priya (polls + customer ask), Jordan (panel coordination), Elena (slides + captions). Need a host — who can MC and handle audience q's?
Priya: I can host if needed for intro and poll readouts.
Maya: Perfect. Assignments and deliverables:
- Sam: demo prep, short recording of the demo steps, and a 2-page troubleshooting doc.
- Ash: infra checklist, pre-seed KV cache steps, warmup script, fallback recording upload.
- Priya: two live poll drafts + customer outreach (ask Anya to join 5 mins).
- Jordan: speaker one-pagers + panel questions doc.
- Elena: slide deck template (short deck) + run-of-show doc.
Deadline: abstracts + slide outline by Fri EOD. Dry run 48 hours before event.
Maya: Proposed run-of-show (45/15):
- 00:00 Host intro + recording note (1:00)
- 01:00 Quick product context + goals (4:00)
- 05:00 Benchmark narrative: baseline vs tuned (8:00)
- 13:00 Live demo walkthrough (7:00)
- 20:00 Attendee tuning exercise + poll #1 (10:00)
- 30:00 Panel Q/A while demo continues (8:00)
- 38:00 Poll #2 & results + quick takeaways (4:00)
- 42:00 CTA & resources (3:00)
- 45:00 Live Qs (up to 15:00)
Elena: Greenroom roles (short):
- Tech: confirm streams, captions, recording on, CDN health, and enable fallback video.
- Host: mic check, slide control, queue panelists.
- Demo lead: final warmup 10 min before go, run warmup script, confirm pre-seeded cache.
- Producer: watch chat, surface urgent questions, trigger fallback if demo stalls.
Greenroom cue script (example):
```
+10m Host: "Please join greenroom. Mics off. Confirm screenshare privilege."
+02m Tech: "Streaming OK, captions on, CDN ready."
+01m Demo lead: "Warmup passed, cache seeded."
+00m Host: "Going live in 3,2,1..."
```
Sam: Quick infra checklist highlights:
- demo endpoint pinned to sandboxes
- sample tokens for presenters and attendees (read-only)
- KV cache pre-seeded for common prompts
- NOC alert channel in case of spikes
- fallback recording uploaded to CDN with time markers
Jordan: Panel flow idea: 5-min quick intros, 10-min scenario-based Qs (prod incident, rollout wins), 10-min live Qs. Keep it tight.
Priya: Poll text drafts (short):
1) "What % of your inference calls need <200ms?" (0-25 / 25-50 / 50-75 / 75-100)
2) "Which matters more for your use-case: latency, cost, or consistency?" (latency/cost/consistency)
Ash: Scheduling: can we do dry run Thu 10am PT? Need at least 60 minutes for full run + postmortem.
Maya: Dry run Thu 10am PT confirmed if all volunteers can make it. Deploy-bot, please create calendar invite.
deploy-bot: Event created: "Dry run  Tuning the Inference Stack (workshop)" on 2026-06-03 10:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/9002
Elena: Marketing assets checklist: 1x 80-word blurb, 3 social hooks, speaker bios (2 lines), 1 hero image, registration form fields (company size, use-case interest). Maya: can you draft the blurb?
Maya: I'll draft promo copy + signup form by EOD tomorrow. Also note: if customer joins on camera we need NDA sign-off by legal 72h before. Priya please handle.
Sam: I'll prep a short prerecorded backup + a notebook with step markers. Uploading to /share/webinars/tuning-workshop.
Ash: I'll run a preflight script 30m before start and post results in the greenroom chat.
Maya: Thanks team. Reminder: abstracts + outlines Fri EOD. Keep messages short in this thread while we coordinate assets. :raised_hands:
